theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) paired with Retro-Futurism Surface Strategy
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Command Center / Terminal Dashboard. Serious, data-dense, high-tech, actionable, and precise.
rules: No generic soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders, subtle light bleeds, and flat deep backgrounds.
Neon accents must be used strictly for functional highlights (CTAs, active states, priority signals), not decoration.
High contrast text for extreme readability.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: The Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4 or gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.surface_treatment: Cardless or flat cards with max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm) or sharp corners (rounded-none). No soft dropshadows. Use inner borders for definition.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data arrays, tabular structures. Strict geometric grids.

SignalTrackerTable.styling_rules: Use Shadcn Table. 1px row borders (border-zinc-800). Header text text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500. Row hover state: hover:bg-lime-400/5 transition-colors. Priority scores can use small neon dot indicators.

ConversionEngine.description: Form section for defining Free Course and Paid Offer.
ConversionEngine.styling_rules: Use Shadcn Forms/Inputs. Inputs should have bg-zinc-950, border-zinc-800, focus:border-lime-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-lime-400. Square edges or rounded-sm.

CTAGenerator.description: Generates 'Leland-Style' banners for CTAs pointing to LearnForge.
CTAGenerator.styling_rules: Use the provided abstract terminal/radar background images overlayed with text. High-contrast white/lime text on dark tech backgrounds.

SyllabusButton.description: Action trigger to generate a syllabus.
SyllabusButton.styling_rules: Primary CTA styling. bg-lime-400 text-black font-bold font-mono tracking-tight hover:bg-lime-500. Add a subtle phosphor icon (e.g., Lightning or Terminal window).

radar_bg.description: Abstract cyber radar grid. Use for the main dashboard header background (with heavy dark overlay) or an empty state graphic.

cta_banner_bg.description: Sleek dark mode command center background. Use strictly for the CTA Generator preview banners.

card_texture.description: Minimalist tech texture with faint grid lines. Use as a subtle background pattern for 'Conversion Engine' cards (bg-cover, very low opacity/blend mode).

iconography_and_motion.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Select technical icons like Terminal, Radar, Lightning, ChartLineUp, Crosshair.
iconography_and_motion.motion: Fast, precise micro-interactions. hover:translate-x-1 on lists, sharp opacity fades. No slow easing.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid. Examples: `data-testid='signal-tracker-table'`, `data-testid='trigger-syllabus-btn'`, `data-testid='free-course-input'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install JetBrains Mono and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts via CSS @import in index.css.
Set up Tailwind config to include the lime-400 and zinc-900 palette.
Build the Signal Tracker as a dense table. Integrate standard Shadcn UI components for the Conversion Engine inputs.
Build a preview card for the CTA generator using 'cta_banner_bg' image.
Ensure dark mode is locked in (e.g. `dark` class forced on root or body).
Do NOT use Space Grotesk or generic SaaS soft shadows.
